title: The Price of Scale in Proactive Memory Recall
abstract: arXiv:2610.34507v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A long-lived assistant that brings up memories without being asked must decide at every turn whether anything in its store is worth an interruption. We show that this decision is a multiple-testing problem whose difficulty grows with the store size $N$. On streaming replays of LongMemEval and LoCoMo, a similarity threshold tuned to 5% false alarms at $N=8$ reaches 87-100% at $N=2048$, across embedding models and for explicit and implicit cues; LLM judges show the same growth from a lower base. We prove that a gate with false-alarm rate $\alpha$ operates at a per-item false-positive rate of about $-\ln(1-\alpha)/N$, which pins its hit rate to the far left of the single-comparison ROC curve and, under regular variation, makes it decay as a power of $N$ with an explicit constant. The resulting prediction matches the hit rate of a per-$N$ oracle threshold to within one percentage point. The analysis explains why lexical and semantic channe

translated_title: 主动记忆召回中规模的代价
translated_abstract: 一个无需被询问便能主动提起记忆的长期助手，必须在每轮交互中判断其记忆库中是否有内容值得打断用户。我们证明这一决策本质上是一个多重假设检验问题，其难度随记忆库规模 N 的增长而加剧。在 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 的流式回放实验中，一个在 N=8 时调校至 5% 误报率的相似度阈值，在 N=2048 时误报率飙升至 87–100%，该现象在各类嵌入模型以及显式与隐式线索中均成立；LLM 判别器虽起点更低，也呈现同样的增长趋势。我们证明，一个误报率为 α 的门控机制，其单条记忆的假阳性率约为 -ln(1-α)/N，这将把其命中率锁定在单次比较 ROC 曲线的最左端，且在正则变化条件下，命中率随 N 以幂次规律衰减并带有显式常数。由此得出的预测与逐 N oracle 阈值的命中率相差在一个百分点以内。该分析解释了为何词汇与语义通道……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明主动记忆召回的门控决策本质上是一个随记忆库规模 N 增长的多重假设检验问题——单条记忆的假阳性率按 -ln(1-α)/N 衰减，导致命中率随 N 呈幂次下降，从理论与实证上解释了记忆库越大、主动记忆触发越容易失效的现象。
en_tdlr: Proactive memory recall is a multiple-testing problem whose per-item false-positive rate decays as -ln(1-α)/N, making hit rates fall as a power of store size N — a theory that quantitatively explains why proactive recall gates degrade as memory grows.
